queries.cypher: MATCH (g:Gene) WHERE g.hugo_symbol = $gene OR $gene IN coalesce(g.aliases, []) RETURN g.hugo_symbol AS hugo_symbol, g.entrez_id AS entrez_id, g.aliases AS aliases, g.categories AS categories, g.is_oncokb_annotated AS is_oncokb_annotated
queries.name: gene_and_aliases

queries.cypher: MATCH (g:Gene {hugo_symbol: $gene})-[:HAS_VARIANT]->(v:Variant)-[:IN_MOLECULAR_PROFILE]->(mp:MolecularProfile)-[:HAS_EVIDENCE]->(e:Evidence)-[:TARGETS_DRUG]->(d:Drug) RETURN g.hugo_symbol AS gene, v.variant_name AS variant, mp.name AS molecular_profile, e.evidence_id AS evidence_id, e.significance AS significance, e.disease AS disease, e.citation_id AS citation_id, d.drug_name AS drug
queries.name: deterministic_gene_to_therapy_path

queries.cypher: MATCH (g:Gene {hugo_symbol: $gene})-[:HAS_VARIANT]->(v:Variant) RETURN v.variant_id AS variant_id, v.variant_name AS variant_name
queries.name: variants

queries.cypher: MATCH (g:Gene {hugo_symbol: $gene})-[:HAS_VARIANT]->(:Variant)-[:IN_MOLECULAR_PROFILE]->(mp:MolecularProfile) RETURN DISTINCT mp.molecular_profile_id AS molecular_profile_id, mp.name AS name
queries.name: molecular_profiles

queries.cypher: MATCH (g:Gene {hugo_symbol: $gene})-[:HAS_VARIANT]->(:Variant)-[:IN_MOLECULAR_PROFILE]->(:MolecularProfile)-[:HAS_EVIDENCE]->(e:Evidence) RETURN e.evidence_id AS evidence_id, e.significance AS significance, e.disease AS disease, e.citation_id AS citation_id
queries.name: clinical_evidence

queries.cypher: MATCH (g:Gene {hugo_symbol: $gene})-[r:INTERACTS_WITH]->(d:Drug) RETURN d.drug_name AS drug, r.interaction_type AS interaction_type, r.source_db AS source_db
queries.name: interacts_with_drugs

queries.cypher: MATCH (g:Gene {hugo_symbol: $gene})-[:HAS_VARIANT]->(:Variant)-[:IN_MOLECULAR_PROFILE]->(:MolecularProfile)-[:HAS_EVIDENCE]->(e:Evidence)-[:CITED_IN]->(p:Publication) RETURN p.pmid AS pmid, p.citation_text AS citation_text
queries.name: publications_via_evidence

queries.cypher: MATCH (t:ClinicalTrial)-[:ASSOCIATED_GENE]->(g:Gene {hugo_symbol: $gene}) OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[:TESTS_DRUG]->(d:Drug) RETURN t.nct_id AS nct_id, t.title AS title, t.phase AS phase, t.status AS status, collect(DISTINCT d.drug_name) AS drugs ORDER BY nct_id
queries.name: trials_by_gene

queries.cypher: MATCH (g:Gene {hugo_symbol: $gene})-[r]-(n) RETURN type(r) AS relationship_type, labels(n) AS neighbour_labels, count(*) AS count
queries.name: any_relationship
